The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]&ndash;aligned '''planetary forces''' of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Kerkoidia/Legends|Kerkoidia]] were in operation during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The famed [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Whorm Loathsom/Legends|Whorm Loathsom]], a native of Kerkoidia, served in his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld's]] forces.
